lines.text: I'm beat, so I'm skipping dinner tonight.

data.define: Used to say you are extremely tired, usually after a long day.

example.text: I'm beat, so I'm skipping dinner tonight.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm beat' after winning a game.

publish.title: What does "I'm beat" mean?
publish.value: I'm beat = I'm completely exhausted. Example: "I'm beat, so I'm skipping dinner tonight." (casual English, US).
